description: Minnesota Extreme Heat Toolkit is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Minnesota Department of Health | Climate and Health Program; U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Local governments and public health professionals can use this guide to help them prepare for and respond to extreme heat events. The toolkit describes practical strategies to prevent morbidity and mortality from extreme heat at the local level. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Extreme Heat. Assets: Critical Facilities, People, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
